composition.title: The travelling jigsaw — from box-lid to atlas

scenes.title: The picture arrives before the pieces
Travel changes what it means to fit
A crossing has a rule — the circle's two charts
The torus loop returns with its winding
The planet appears, and the making of the picture returns
The atlas travels with the means to revise it

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-tr.title: the box lid — the destination already visible
the edge frame — built first
sorted pieces — awaiting their place
the lid's silent power — it decides which anomaly is merely misplaced
the flat assembly — meeting a turn it cannot preserve
the travelled world — curvature beyond the frame
the question reaching the frame: what relation was lost in this rendering?
recording how a view was made — from where, across which region, under what projection
the circle covered by two charts — opposite poles omitted
the shared point (x,y)=(3/5,4/5)
v = 1/u — the declared transformation on the overlap
du/dt=2 ⇒ dv/dt=−2/9 — even motion must be transformed
height 4/5 in either account
the flat quotient — one surface address, infinitely many plane representatives
the loop γ(t)=[2t,−t]
the lifted endpoint (2,−1) — displacement retained
the disk abstraction — every loop contractible; the winding classes are what it lacks
four sides, two generators, one vertex, one face — counts with distinct offices
the planetary view — Earth gathered around a shared frame
as box-lid — "planetary" the unexamined scale under which lives are counted
whose planet, computed by whom, on whose gauge?
the diaphanous turn — location, time, production and transformations inspectable
the atlas — charts, transitions, obstructions
the first picture reopened — its achievement retained, frame now visible
